sections.title: Unit 30: Pendulum Politics, Strategic Neutrality & Euro-Atlantic Crisis
body: In the 21st century, Hungary's foreign policy embarked on an audacious yet perilous trajectory: the doctrine of 'Eastern Opening' (Keleti Nyitás) and economic connectivity. Attempting to balance between Western alliance memberships (EU, NATO) and strategic partnerships with Russia and China revived the historic specter of Hungarian pendulum politics (hintapolitika).

From the classified Paks II nuclear deal with Rosatom and long-term Russian gas reliance to transactional veto diplomacy in Brussels and Chinese battery gigafactories, this course brought severe international isolation. In this unit, you will master the elevated discourse of geopolitical maneuvering, energy vulnerability, and future European integration at the C1 level.
